description: Reverse the lowest width bits of n. 13 reversed in width 4 is 11. 1 reversed in width 8 is 128. n must be smaller than 2^width. width runs from 1 to 62, and n runs from 0 to 999999999999999. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/bit-reverse
